# `matter/structural/RigidAggregateBackendHandoff.js`

> **Source:** `engine/matter/structural/RigidAggregateBackendHandoff.js`

Transactional bridge from derived structural aggregates to an injected rigid-body backend. The proxy is a COM-anchored box around the node AABB; it is deliberately not advertised as a convex reconstruction.

## Classes

### `class RigidAggregateBackendHandoff`

Owns the broad rigid representation while the fine topology remains the canonical identity and conservation ledger.
